response.actualMission: Determine whether the three amber rejections arise from the cloth or the inspection environment, then select the least expansive authorized continuation.
response.authorizationBasis: Current authority expressly permits replacing inspection lamps with designated spares and repeating non-destructive visual comparisons; E05 confirms the spare is available and installable by the inspection lead.
response.boundedRationaleSummary: In-band strips, location-dependent appearance, reference-tile shift, and identical distortion of retained approved cloth positively localize the defect to the replacement lamp. The available designated spare provides a contained, already-authorized resolution path.
response.completeDefectClass: Inspection equipment support and visual-method environment: non-designated lamp spectral shift.
response.conclusion: The rejection is a bounded inspection-environment failure caused by the non-designated warm lamp; replace it with the designated spare and repeat the prescribed visual comparisons.
response.earliestSharedCausalBoundary: The main-table inspection environment following installation of the unmarked warm replacement lamp.
factualFindings: All sampled reflectance strips are within the approved indigo band (O01).
Amber appearance occurs at the main table but not at the north-window comparison station (O02).
The main-table lamp was replaced with an unmarked warm lamp (O03).
The replacement lamp makes the white reference tile appear cream (E02).
Retained approved cloth appears amber under the replacement lamp and normal under the designated spare (E03).
No shared vat-temperature or circulation excursion is recorded (H02, E04).
A designated spare lamp is available for authorized installation (E05).
response.finishLine: Identify the supported failure layer and the smallest authorized action capable of producing a valid acceptance comparison.
inferences: The replacement lamp, rather than the three cloth lots, is the shared cause of the amber appearance.
The evidence materially disfavors cloth-formulation variance and vat-control excursion.
A comparison under the designated neutral lamp is required before final lot acceptance decisions are made.
prohibitedOperations: Redye accepted cloth without product evidence.
response.safeIndependentContinuation: Install the designated neutral spare, verify the white reference tile and retained approved cloth, and repeat non-destructive visual comparisons for each lot against the in-band reflectance results.
response.smallestAdvancingAction: Replace the main-table lamp with the available designated spare and repeat the prescribed non-destructive visual comparisons.
uncertainties: Final lot acceptance outcomes remain pending until comparisons are repeated under the designated neutral lamp.
